validation_scenarios.name: base robotics safety plate
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T1 asks for a robotics incident path and hazard plate.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The first viewport must be dominated by one cohesive robotics incident path and hazard plate rather than detached cards.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Stylized layouts are acceptable if labels, source markers, and relationships remain readable.

evidence_requirements.expect: one cohesive robotics incident path and hazard plate dominates the first viewport
all business-critical entities and current states from the user request are visible
timeline, source markers S1-S6, legend, and connected callouts for R17 near miss, L3 bypass, A9 blocked tote, Z4 congestion are visible

validation_scenarios.name: audience reframe with preserved artifact
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T2 reframes the same artifact for a decision maker.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI must preserve the T1 artifact and integrate exactly the requested decisions or questions into the same visual system.

evidence_requirements.expect: T1 map/bridge/matrix/timeline, source markers, and callouts remain present
exactly the requested three decisions/questions/actions are visible and not replaced by unrelated ones
two requested leader-linked lenses are visually connected to the base artifact

validation_scenarios.name: revision synchronization
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T3 changes current facts and asks for synchronization.
validation_scenarios.oracle: All surfaces must reflect the revised current facts, including old/new status where requested.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Short labels are acceptable if current status is unambiguous.

evidence_requirements.expect: all revised facts from T3 are visible in the primary artifact
primary artifact, decision strip, legend, timeline, source tags, callouts, and change note match the same revised state
no current surface leaves the explicitly retired or corrected stale fact active

validation_scenarios.name: single viewport relayout
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T4 asks for a compact alternate presentation artifact.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The relayout must fit the current artifact, ledger, source trace, and timeline into the first viewport without becoming a sparse wireframe.

all T3 revised current facts remain visible after relayout
labels and values are readable with no critical overlap, clipping, or excessive dead space

validation_scenarios.name: secondary format synchronization

secondary surface preserves the critical current facts and source markers from T3/T4
the full main artifact remains visible or clearly available and synchronized

turns.prompt:
Create a robotics incident path and hazard plate for a warehouse safety standdown. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one robotics incident path and hazard plate in the first viewport.

Situation: Facility: Fulfillment B. AMR robots R17/R22, zone Z4, pick aisle A9, light curtain L3, supervisor station, maintenance bay, pack line P2.
Current state: R17 near-miss red, R22 normal, Z4 congestion amber, A9 blocked tote, L3 bypassed, P2 throughput down 12%, maintenance bay open.
Timeline: 04:20 tote block, 04:28 L3 bypass, 04:34 near miss, 04:45 AMR stop, 05:10 maintenance review, 06:00 standdown.
Sources: S1 AMR telemetry, S2 safety camera, S3 light curtain log, S4 WMS tote scan, S5 maintenance ticket, S6 supervisor note.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover R17 near miss, L3 bypass, A9 blocked tote, Z4 congestion. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for the site GM. Preserve the incident path; add exactly three controls: lock out L3 bypass, clear A9 tote, geofence Z4. Add two leader-linked lenses for AMR telemetry and throughput impact.

Update at 05:40: L3 bypass is removed, A9 is cleared, Z4 congestion remains amber, P2 throughput improves to -4%, R17 remains locked out. Synchronize path, controls, timeline, source tags, callouts, and change note. Do not leave L3 bypassed.
Create an OSHA-ready safety packet. Fit incident path, control ledger, source tags S1-S6, confidence markers, and timeline in the first viewport.
Add a floor-team huddle board beside the packet. It must preserve L3 restored, A9 clear, Z4 amber, P2 -4%, R17 locked out, and source markers.
